repo.description:
### Background

NATS is an open source messaging system for cloud, on-premises and edge deployments.

NATS Server supports certificate pinning and can recheck active client connections when TLS pin settings change during configuration reload.

### Problem Description

The reload check used the previous pin set instead of the newly loaded one. A client using a removed pin could remain connected even though the operator intended to revoke its access. NATS, MQTT and WebSocket client checks were affected.

### Affected Versions

The issue is fixed in v2.14.8 and v2.15.1. Earlier versions containing the affected functionality are vulnerable; the first affected version has not been established for this notice.

### Workarounds

Upgrade to a fixed release.

### References

 * GHSA advisory: <https://github.com/nats-io/nats-server/security/advisories/GHSA-mf72-w5mg-h2mg>
 * Credit: ARSB (@ARSB1)
repo.summary: Removing TLS certificate pins does not revoke existing client connections
